subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw accept a new public `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` setting for lane wait diagnostics, and should it hot-apply through config reload or be restart-only?
rationale: The requested fix is narrow and useful, but it adds public configuration surface in a compatibility-sensitive diagnostics path, so automation should not choose the permanent config contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queued entries honor the reloaded value.

options.title: Accept restart-only setting
options.body: Keep the config key but document and test restart-required semantics instead of promising config-reload behavior.

options.title: Decline the config knob
options.body: Leave the threshold fixed or solve log noise through a broader diagnostics policy, then close the linked implementation path.

recommendation.title: Accept hot-applied diagnostics key
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR after schema, types, help/reference docs, generated docs, tests, and reload planning all agree that future queued entries honor the reloaded value.
